continuity.arc_goal: Implement linked workflows MVP — parent-to-child workflow links with completion blocking, cross-partition cancellation, and observable state graphs. Success = end-to-end integration test passes with full create/complete/cancel/remove flow.

progress_update.summary: We conducted a thorough plan review of the linked workflows MVP implementation plan, identifying and agreeing on 8 simplifications. Rewrote the plan with vertical-slice phases, strict TDD, and significantly reduced scope. The plan is now leaner and ready for task breakdown and implementation.
progress_update.goal: Implement linked workflows MVP with cross-partition support. Success = parent workflow starts linked child, child blocks parent completion, cancellation propagates through link tree, RemoveLink orphans child, end-to-end integration test passes.
accomplished: Completed detailed plan review with 3 parallel codebase analysis agents (InvocationStatus blast radius, ServiceInvocationResponseSink usage, outbox message patterns)

Agreed on 8 simplifications: defer onCompleted/HandlerInvocation sink, drop active_children_count (query link table), reuse AttachInvocation outbox for sink registration, vertical slice phases, parent-keyed only link table, omit child_invocation_id, drop ScanLinkTable, strict TDD
Rewrote implementation plan with 3 vertical-slice phases instead of 6 horizontal phases
Updated design doc deferred section to include onCompleted deferral
Verified Completing variant needs full InFlightInvocationMetadata for transition to Completed
progress_update.now: Just completed the plan rewrite. All simplifications incorporated. Plan is ready for task breakdown via /spectre:create_tasks.
next_steps: Create task breakdown from the updated plan via /spectre:create_tasks
Phase 1: Link table storage stack + CreateLink journal entry + Link sink variant (TDD)
Phase 2: Completing variant + LinkCompletionNotification + completion path changes (TDD happy path)
Phase 3: RemoveLink + cancel propagation through links (TDD unhappy path)
constraints: Cross-partition links from day one — all link operations use outbox messages
Links stored in dedicated table with parent-keyed index only
Strict TDD — red-green-refactor, no deferred coverage tasks
Restart-as-new disallowed on linked workflows (prevents stale notification issues)
decisions: No active_children_count — query link table for Running links instead of maintaining denormalized counter
No child_invocation_id — links are entity-to-entity (ServiceId → ServiceId), disallow restart-as-new on linked workflows
Defer HandlerInvocation sink / onCompleted to post-MVP — objects use AttachInvocationCommand with PartitionProcessor sink instead
Completion delivers Result<T, E> only — no status field, no inline frozen graph
Completing variant carries InFlightInvocationMetadata + buffered ResponseResult, no active_children_count
Link table keyed by parent entity only (with parent-keyed index)
RemoveLink included in MVP — graph curation is load-bearing
End-to-end integration test included in MVP scope
Cancellation is local per node — each node cancels its own direct children
open_questions: Graph traversal API — how does a parent inspect the frozen state graph of completed children? (deferred)
Orphan GC policy — default timeout for orphaned workflows? (deferred)
risks: Completing variant touches ~25 files — significant but compiler-guided ripple
New OutboxMessage::LinkCompletionNotification variant requires wiring through WAL protocol, shuffler, and state machine dispatch
